title: IIU investigates death of woman in RCMP custody
article: Manitoba's police watchdog is investigating after a woman died in RCMP custody in a northern Manitoba community.

The Independent Investigation Unit of Manitoba said in a release Friday that RCMP have told them officers arrested a woman they allege to have been intoxicated around 7:40 p.m. Wednesday in Chemawawin.

She was taken to the Chemawawin RCMP detachment and lodged in cells. On Thursday around 10 a.m., she was found unresponsive in her cell. CPR was started immediately. Nurses from the community's nursing station attended and pronounced the woman dead.

The IIU has assumed responsibility for this investigation in accordance with Section 65(1) of the Police Services Act. As this matter involves a fatality, a request for a civilian monitor will be made to the Manitoba Police Commission.
Witnesses or other individuals who have information or video footage that may assist this investigation are asked to contact the IIU toll free at 1-844-667-6060.
